description: This file defines the SNSettingsService class, which manages application settings including fetching, updating, and deleting settings, as well as providing configuration details such as email backup labels and cloud provider URLs.

classes.name: SNSettingsService
classes.description: A service class that interacts with user settings, providing methods to retrieve, update, and delete settings, as well as generating URLs and labels related to cloud providers and email backup frequencies.

methods.name: initializeFromDisk
methods.description: Initializes the provider by creating a new SettingsGateway instance using the provided API and session manager.

methods.name: listSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all settings via the settings gateway.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Fetches a specific setting by its name.

methods.name: getSubscriptionSetting
methods.description: Retrieves subscription-related setting by its name.

methods.name: updateSetting
methods.description: Updates a setting identified by name with the provided payload, optionally marked as sensitive.

methods.name: getDoesSensitiveSettingExist
methods.description: Checks if a sensitive setting exists by its name.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes a specific setting by its name.

methods.name: getEmailBackupFrequencyOptionLabel
methods.description: Returns a descriptive label for a given email backup frequency.

methods.name: getCloudProviderIntegrationUrl
methods.description: Generates a URL endpoint for cloud provider integrations based on the provider name.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the service, cleaning up references.

ctags.name: SNSettingsService
ctags.pattern: /^export class SNSettingsService extends AbstractService implements SettingsClientInterface {$/
